title: Modeling Authentic Research Trajectories: A Graph View of Research Ideation
abstract: arXiv:2610.27337v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The research idea in a published paper is rarely the project's initial idea. Between the two lies a closed-loop process in which researchers run experiments, derive insights, identify challenges, explore the literature, and revise the idea, with each step motivated by evidence and reasoning they can articulate. We call the path one idea takes through this process, with the evidence and reasoning behind each step, its authentic research trajectory. Although it underlies every scientific contribution, it is rarely recorded. Existing LLM-based research agents generate an idea once, refine it against reviews, literature, or their own experimental results, or search over candidate ideas and experiments. In all of them the text of the idea evolves, while the evidence and reasoning that connected one version to the next are discarded. We propose the Research Progress Graph (RPG), a representation of authentic and complete research trajectories.

translated_title: 建模真实研究轨迹：研究构思的图视角
translated_abstract: 已发表论文中的研究想法很少是项目最初的想法。在两者之间存在着一个闭环过程，研究者在此过程中进行实验、获得洞察、识别挑战、探索文献并修改想法，每一步都有他们能够清晰阐述的证据和推理作为支撑。我们将一个想法在这一过程中所走过的路径，连同每一步背后的证据和推理，称为其真实研究轨迹。尽管它是每一项科学贡献的基础，却很少被记录下来。现有的基于大语言模型（LLM）的研究智能体要么一次性生成想法，再根据评审意见、文献或自身实验结果进行改进，要么在候选想法和实验中搜索。在所有这些方法中，想法的文本在不断演进，而连接前后版本的证据和推理却被丢弃了。我们提出了研究进展图，一种对真实且完整研究轨迹的表示方法。
tldr: 该论文提出了研究进展图（RPG），一种通过保留研究想法每次演进背后的证据与推理，来表示真实且完整研究轨迹的新方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Research Progress Graph (RPG), a novel representation of authentic and complete research trajectories that preserves the evidence and reasoning behind each evolution of a research idea.
